tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Search AgentGid for agents, coding tools, APIs, models and stacks that fit a goal, e.g. 'Solana LP copy-trading bot', 'web search API for a research agent under $50/month', 'generate 3D models for a game'. Returns candidates grouped by kind with prices, free tiers and links. Use this first, then get

tools.name: list_api_categories
tools.description: List the categories of APIs for agents AgentGid compares (web search, scraping, sandboxes, memory, vector DBs, LLM gateways, email, voice, payments, blockchain RPC, DEX swap, crypto data, 3D, image, audio, video generation).

tools.name: find_apis
tools.description: Compare APIs in one category on official price, free tier, MCP support, SDK downloads and status. Filters are optional.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Full details of one API: pricing (free tier, plans, usage price, notes), SDK packages, MCP server, status, cheaper alternatives.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Details of an AI agent or developer tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Headroom ...): pricing, plan usage limits, live status and incidents, latest release, popularity, safety settings.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Live status of agents and APIs from their official status pages, with incidents in the last 30 days.

tools.name: model_prices
tools.description: API prices of LLMs (per 1M input/output tokens, context) and which agents can use them. Optional filter by name.

tools.name: real_world_usage
tools.description: From public GitHub repos set up for AI coding agents: the MCP servers developers connect (overall or per agent), common combinations, and per domain (Solana bots, EVM apps, games, agent products, mobile) the APIs, SDKs and packages they use.

tools.name: current_deals
tools.description: Active official offers from the makers of AI agents and tools: discounts, free access, extra usage, credits, student, startup and open-source programs. Each comes from the vendor's own page, with its end date and source.

tools.name: limit_resets
tools.description: When Anthropic and OpenAI last reset the 5-hour and weekly usage limits of Claude Code and Codex, how often they do it, and recent resets with a link to each announcement.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: How an agent's plans and prices changed month by month, read from archived copies of its official pricing page.

tools.name: find_assets
tools.description: Sources of stock photos, video, music, voiceover, 3D models, textures, icons and fonts for apps and agents: price, whether the license allows commercial use and needs credit, and how an agent connects (MCP, API, package, download).

tools.name: find_skills
tools.description: Agent Skills packs (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents that read skills, from public GitHub repos: what the pack covers, number of skills, stars and the AgentGid page with install commands.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: List the project types AgentGid has a tested kit for (a 2D browser platformer, an interactive 3D web scene, a short-video pipeline, video and audio to text, a PDF tool...): id, title, the questions that shape the kit, and when it was test-built by a coding agent.

tools.name: plan_project
tools.description: Get a project kit: one part per job from AgentGid's catalogs (with version, license and reasons), install lines, checks, and with files=true the AGENTS.md brief, CREDITS.md, first prompt and MCP setup files. Give a recipe id from list_recipes or the goal in plain words. If no recipe fits the goal, i

tools.name: report_kit_issue
tools.description: Tell AgentGid's editors what was wrong, missing or out of date in a kit's AGENTS.md after you built from it: a command that failed, a version that did not install, a step that did not work. Only the editors read it; it is never published. Leave out keys, personal data and the person's code.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_api_categories, report_kit_issue · Private data: model_prices, plan_project · Public sink: list_api_categories · Destructive: limit_resets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_api_categories, report_kit_issue · Private data: model_prices, plan_project · Public sink: list_api_categories · Destructive: limit_resets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
